old_caption: The video captures a serene scene of a sky at sunset or sunrise. The sky is filled with clouds bathed in vibrant hues of orange, pink, and purple, creating a contrast against darker blue tones in the upper sky. The clouds are in constant motion, slowly drifting across the frame, their edges softly illuminated by warm light. As the video progresses, the colors deepen and shift, reflecting changing light conditions. The overall atmosphere is tranquil and mesmerizing, evoking a sense of peace and natural beauty. There are no visible objects, characters, or animals present; the focus remains solely on the sky and its ever-changing palette of colors. The camera remains stationary throughout the video, allowing viewers to absorb the intricate details and subtle movements of the clouds.

caption: The video captures a close-up view of a sunset sky filled with layered clouds, with no sun disk, horizon, or ground in frame. A bright orange glow dominates the upper-left, while a diagonal band of lit cloud runs from the top-center down toward the lower-right. Darker purple and mauve cloud banks occupy the right side and lower-middle, with thin orange wisps glowing through gaps near the bottom. Across the excerpt the cloud formations drift and morph very slowly, so consecutive frames differ only slightly. The orange patch in the upper-left gradually softens as its boundary with the purple sky shifts inward. The illuminated diagonal band subtly changes shape and brightness, and the dark purple mass along the right edge creeps a little leftward. Overall the color balance deepens toward purple on the right while the orange at the lower-center keeps glowing.
